topic: set up a separate wifi network for guests
core_question: How do I set up a guest wifi network so visitors don't use my main network?
answer_summary: In the router admin settings, turn on the guest network option, give it its own name and password separate from the main network.
persona: dramatic and exasperated; using casual slang
